'''Tetsu Inada''' (Japanese: '''稲田徹''' ''Inada Tetsu'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Inada was born on July 1, 1972, in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actor as an adult. He voiced one of his best-known roles as [[Pastoria City]] [[Gym Leader]] [[Crasher Wake]], during {{aniseries|DP}} of the {{pkmn|animated series}}. He later voiced [[Matt]] in [[Pokémon Generations]]. Inada is currently affiliated with the talent agency {{wp|Aoni Production}}.
